schemes.apiKey.description: "The `Authorization` header must contain the API key. The value should be prefixed with `API-Key` followed by a space and the actual API key.\n"

schemes.oauth2.description: "Send the authenticating user to the PandaDoc OAuth2 request URL. We recommend a button or a link titled
"Connect to PandaDoc" if you are connecting users from a custom application. Users will see the "Authorize Application" screen.
When the user clicks "Authorize", PandaDoc redirects the user back to your site with an authorization code inside the URL.
The authorization code is valid for 60 seconds and can be used only once, so exchange it for an access token immediately.

https://app.pandadoc.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id={client_id}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}&scope=read%20write&response_type=code

Request `read`, `write`, or both as space-separated `read write`. `read+write` is deprecated.

`client_id` and `redirect_uri` values should match your application settings.
"
